notes: All 25 candidates read in full. Four program-list pages: University of Houston Bauer Management & Leadership placements (bauer.uh.edu and www.cba.uh.edu are the same page on two hosts; 28 names, 2010-2020, academic positions only, the page says 'accepted academic positions at' so non-academic graduates may be omitted); University of Kentucky Gatton Management initial placements (16 names, 2007-2018, employer and title, includes one postdoc and one adjunct); University of Bristol School of Management PhD job market (8 current PhD students in 2021 seeking jobs, with fields such as marketing, organisation studies, entrepreneurship and one on fashion supply chains; no placements stated; page carries personal contact emails that must not be copied into datasets). All Houston and Kentucky names are in management/organisational behaviour and strategy areas, not operations; area classification is left to the integrator. The eleven apice.unibo.it pages are individual bachelor's/master's thesis records of the DISI computer-science group (plus one tag page) and are outside scope. The three merage.uci.edu dissertation URLs are 404 shells after a site migration; the UC Davis pair and the Houston placement pair are duplicate hosts of one page. No institution-by-host reassignment was needed.
